value.rationale: The closest primary paper explicitly studies the sign and zero set of excess kurtosis to characterize non-Gaussian phases, and warns that zero kurtosis is insufficient to identify Gaussianity. The exact *sixth* cumulant on precisely that naturally selected full curve is a motivated observable that distinguishes the phase and yields a nontrivial strict sign and sharp monotone standardized range. Unlike a routine exercise or a parameter substitution, it requires the reversal-sensitive sixth-order stationary hierarchy and gives a measurable quantitative replacement diagnostic valid at all strictly positive angular diffusivities. The physical scope and nonclaims are explicit; no paper-sized extension is required for this independently useful exact benchmark.
